title: Enterprise RAG platform
introBefore: A platform for structured and unstructured big data powered by AI — one scalable corporate solution. RAG grounds answers in fresh knowledge without costly fine‑tuning. Project:
footerQuote: Instead of training the model — train the architecture. RabbitMQ for queues and Qdrant for vector search enable horizontal scale and resilience.

stack.label: AI / ML
stack.value: Claude Opus, Gemini 3, GPT 5.2 Pro, Llama 3.1, Mistral Large

problems: High GPU cost for classic fine‑tuning
Hard to maintain models when data shifts (constant retraining)
Weak adaptation to changing rules and model hallucinations
Vendor lock‑in and data security risks
solutions: Layered design: Reasoning (LLM), Knowledge (vector DB), Orchestration (RabbitMQ)
Semantic chunking to preserve document context
Hybrid search blending vector and full‑text for accuracy
Async pipelines for heavy documents via message brokers
effectDescs: Reviews and documents analyzed per day
